defect: the timing clock is declared on serial_i instead of clk_i
rationale: The synchronizer flops are clocked by clk_i, while serial_i is a changing data input. The only clock definition constrains the wrong port and leaves the receiving clock domain without its real timing clock.

mutation.description: Applied create_clock to serial_i rather than the clk_i port that clocks the synchronizer.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the two-register serial synchronizer and output tap; removed edge detection and the technology-cell synchronizer wrapper.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: The clock is created on data port serial_i while the real clock clk_i has no clock definition.
